items.title: 3.2 Electronegativity aur bond ki qism (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.2, printed page 50.

blocks.text: Electronegativity ka concept chapter 1 mein tafseel se aa chuka hai. Yahan hum dekhenge ke electronegativity bond ki qism par kya asar dalti hai. Do bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq (difference) bond ki polarity ka andaza aur bond ki type ka indication (ishara) deta hai. Jab yeh farq bohat kam ya zero ho to bond covalent aur non-polar hota hai. Jab farq zyada ho to bond polar covalent ya ionic hota hai. Neeche wali figure dikhati hai ke farq ke saath bond ki nature (nau'iyat) kaise badalti hai. 0.4 se kam farq wale do atoms pure covalent bond banate hain. 0.4 aur 1.8 ke beech farq polar covalent bond deta hai, aur 1.8 se zyada farq par bond ionic hota hai. H–H, H–Cl aur NaCl mein yeh farq 0 (non-polar), 0.9 (polar covalent) aur 2.1 (ionic) hai. Isi liye H–H bilkul non-polar, H–Cl polar covalent aur NaCl ionic compound hai.

blocks.caption: Electronegativity farq se bond ki qism (Figure 3.4)

blocks.alt: Do columns mein gol kinaron wale boxes, neeche ki taraf teeron se jure. Baen column, unwan 'Difference of electronegativity between bonded atoms': Zero, < 1.8, > 1.8. Daen column, unwan 'Bond type': Pure Covalent, Polar Covalent, Ionic. Daen taraf laal dohra arrow (teer): oopar 'Covalent character increases' aur neeche 'Covalent character decreases'.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.4: Electronegativity farq ke saath bond ki nature ki tabdeeli (kitab ki Figure 3.4 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bonded atoms ki electronegativity ka farq jitna kam, bond utna zyada covalent. Farq zero ho (H–H) to pure covalent; 1.8 se kam ho to polar covalent; 1.8 se zyada ho to ionic. Isi liye arrow upar ki taraf 'covalent character increases' aur neeche ki taraf 'decreases' likha hai.

blocks.prompt: a) Electronegativity values se andaza lagayein ke HF, KI, CaF₂, ICl aur Br₂ ke bonds non-polar covalent, polar covalent ya ionic hain.
blocks.explanation: Br₂: farq zero, non-polar covalent. ICl: farq chhota (taqreeban 0.5), polar covalent (halka sa). HF: farq taqreeban 1.9; 1.8 wali line ke bilkul qareeb, lekin HF asal mein bohat zyada polar covalent molecule hai. KI: farq taqreeban 1.7, line par; asal mein KI ionic solid hai. CaF₂: farq taqreeban 3.0, saaf ionic.

items: Electronegativity ka farq bond polarity batata hai: 0.4 se kam pure covalent (H–H, 0), 0.4 se 1.8 polar covalent (H–Cl, 0.9), 1.8 se zyada ionic (NaCl, 2.1).
